notes.title: VERITUS ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424641/b27b67b9fc3bdc307a7cf47b585ad64d8dee0924.png[/img]

[h2]The Veritus Original Soundtrack is Out Now![/h2]

After a bit of hassle and a long wait, we are happy to announce that you can now purchase the OST for Veritus on Steam for your library! John did an incredible job on the music for this game, so we are all very excited for the community at large to be able to listen to it on the go.

This time around there are a total of 78 tracks including all of the tracks that made it into the game, PLUS a few bonus, unused songs that we couldn't bear to thow away.

We hope you enjoy!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102980/Veritus_Soundtrack/
